title: Paul's help when he started drumming
summary: Paul was already playing and gave him ideas, but his father taught him nothing about music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I learned him some drums. Yeah, I did. Can you tell us any more about when you started? Did your brother help you, Paul? Had he been playing long before that that you can remember? Well, Paul was playing long before I started. I knew he was older, of course. Yeah, he was playing long. Playing around with different bands around the office. Did he help you any? Did he show you how to hold the sticks or anything? Well, he did. Give me ideas. Paul, give me ideas. Did your father ever teach you anything about music that isn't reading music? No.
